description:
Scope of Engagement. The TCG will address global technology trends relevant to acquisition decision-making, including but not limited to:

  • Peer and near-peer technology trends
  • Threat armor and anti-armor capabilities
  • Survivability and Lethality challenges in contested environments
  • Counter-UAS and emerging aerial threat considerations
  • Threat static-displays

Classification and Security

  • TCG discussions at minimum will be conducted at the SECRET//NOFORN level.
  • No classified information will be posted to SAM.gov.
  • Participation is limited to U.S. citizens with a current SECRET clearance (or higher) affiliated with a cleared U.S. Facility.

Eligibility

  • U.S.-based companies with an active Facility Clearance (FCL).
  • Experience supporting armor systems, sensors, sUAS and counter-sUAS, electronic warfare, or threat modeling.

Requested Information from Industry

Interested parties are requested to submit the following unclassified information to the POCs:

  1. Company name, CAGE code, and primary point of contact
  2. Confirmation of facility clearance and clearance level
  3. Brief description of relevant capabilities and portfolio alignment (no more than 1 paragraph in an email to the POC)
  4. General areas of threat or intelligence interested related to armor and/or anti-armor
  5. Anticipated number of proposed attendees and clearance levels (Limit of 5, ideally system engineers or personnel with security clearances that influence capability development)

Anticipated logistics

  • Timeframe: 19-21 May 2026
  • Location: Cleared facility in Charlottesville, VA.
  • Format: In-person, classified environment.

Specific location and participation details will be provided to selected participants.

Important Disclaimers

  • Participation is voluntary and at no cost to the Government
  • The Government will not reimburse travel or participation expenses
  • The Government reserves the right to limit participation to ensure balanced and effective discussions given space constraints
  • This notice does not obligate the Government to take any future acquisition action
